paper.title_en: Probing Memory-Burdened Primordial Black Holes with High-Energy Neutrinos
paper.abstract_en: The memory-burden effect can suppress the late-time evaporation of primordial black holes (PBHs), allowing those that would otherwise have evaporated via Hawking radiation to survive until the present epoch. These lighter PBHs emit high-energy and ultra-high-energy neutrinos, opening the tentalizing possibility of discovery via neutrino telescopes. We study the constraints on memory-burdened PBHs from current IceCube HESE, MESE, and EHE data; and forecast the sensitivity reach of IceCube-Gen2 radio and GRAND200k. In particular, we study how this signal depends on whether the initial PBH population is described by a log-normal mass function or by a monochromatic one. We find that log-normally distributed populations can be more strongly constrained than monochromatic populations with the same median mass primarily because their low-mass tails enhance the high-energy neutrino flux. We show that current IceCube data provide the leading limits for a lower memory burden parameter $k$, whereas the projected radio detectors become substantially more sensitive for higher values of $k$. We also study a scenario where future experiments would see a positive signal coming from PBHs. We consider a representative 30-event signal in IceCube-Gen2 radio and GRAND200k and study how well one could distinguish the two mass-function hypotheses. We find that it is easier to disfavor the monochromatic distribution when the log-normal distribution is assumed to be true. Finally, we study how well the parameters of the memory-burdened PBHs can be estimated in these future experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了记忆负担效应对原初黑洞蒸发的抑制及其高能中微子信号，属于黑洞热力学和天体粒子物理交叉领域，且与PTA相关。研究内容具有理论深度，研究方法严谨，对当前和未来实验的约束进行了综合分析，具有较高的新颖性和清晰度。
decision.title_zh: 利用高能中微子探测记忆负担的原初黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 记忆负担效应可以抑制原初黑洞（PBHs）的晚期蒸发，使得那些原本会通过霍金辐射蒸发的较轻原初黑洞能够存活至今。这些较轻的原初黑洞发射高能和超高中微子，为通过中微子望远镜发现它们提供了诱人的可能性。我们研究了来自当前IceCube HESE、MESE和EHE数据对记忆负担原初黑洞的约束，并预测了IceCube-Gen2无线电和GRAND200k的灵敏度范围。特别是，我们研究了当初始原初黑洞种群由对数正态质量函数或单色质量函数描述时，该信号如何依赖于此。我们发现，对数正态分布的种群可以比具有相同中值质量的单色种群受到更强的约束，主要是因为它们的低质量尾部增强了高能中微子通量。我们表明，当前的IceCube数据为较低的记忆负担参数$k$提供了领先的限制，而投影无线电探测器对于较高的$k$值变得更为敏感。我们还研究了一个未来实验可能看到来自原初黑洞的正信号的情景。我们考虑了在IceCube-Gen2无线电和GRAND200k中具有代表性的30事件信号，并研究了在两种质量函数假设之间如何区分。我们发现，当假定对数正态分布为真时，更容易排斥单色分布。最后，我们研究了在这些未来实验中，记忆负担原初黑洞的参数估计效果如何。
